Description: Experimental measurements and derived result tables accompanying the BlindVision evaluation.
Numerical values are retained as supplied; repository packaging does not alter reported measurements.
data/raw/participant_trials_breakdown.csv contains seven participant rows totaling 100 navigation trials and 96 successful trials.
data/raw/participant_trial_outcomes_100.csv contains 100 participant-subset trial records with 96 successful and four partial-success outcomes.
YOLO_Metrics.csv and Heldout_Test.csv contain the reported detection evaluation results; Confusion_Matrix.csv contains the ten-class confusion matrix (Table IV).
Complete image/label data, trained weights, epoch-wise training logs, and raw confusion-matrix event data are not included in this release.
